description: Lists the signed-in player's groups, tournaments and hidden-list games (a group's game where everyone seals a list in secret before the reveal), each with its token, url, dates and your place in it: membership, entry status, whether you sealed a list, and the size you seal at. Pass includeOpen to also list public groups and tournaments you could join. Read one with get_my_group or get_my_event. Requires mcp:read.

includeOpen.description: Also list public groups and tournaments you are not in.

name: list_my_events
title: List my groups and tournaments
